861:t_085:7.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Hey, how the heck do you know that!?」

861:t_085:8.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Of course! I read 'Monthly Men's Super Robot Wars'!」

861:t_086:4.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「This mission was pretty rough too, wasn't it...」

861:t_086:5.en:
$$くらら$$
「If you're going to say that, isn't the player the one who's most tired?」

861:t_086:6.en:
$$葵$$
「You're right...! They fought with us all the way, didn't they...? Thank you.」

861:t_086:7.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Thank you for your hard work.」

861:t_086:10.en:
$$葵$$
「So next time, stick with us aaagain!」

861:t_087:3.en:
$$田中司令$$
「I've been waiting for you, everyone~. I'm afraid I'm better at taking breaks than at fighting, you see...」

861:t_087:4.en:
$$田中司令$$
「No no, it's not that I'm slacking off, you know? Moderation in all things is the key, yes.」

861:t_087:5.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Besides, there's one last job left... Are you ready, $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$?」

861:t_087:7.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Ahem! '3rd Super Robot Wars Z'! Next time, toooo...!」

861:t_088:3.en:
$$さやか$$
「I saw that, $$甲児$$! Skipping training - what are you doing!?」

861:t_088:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「H-Hey, I want to play SRW too! Let it slide, $$さやか$$!」

861:t_088:5.en:
$$さやか$$
「Oh, fine... In exchange, I'll play with you.」

861:t_088:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「Okay, $$さやか$$. ...But SRW is a single-player-only game...」

861:t_088:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「I know! If I team up $$マジンガー$$ and $$ビューナスＡ$$ as a Tag, it'll feel like the two of us are fighting together!」

861:t_088:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Nice going, $$甲児$$. Guess the special training on women's hearts paid off too.」

861:t_088:10.en:
$$隼人$$
「Heh... Being taught by you, of all people... just how low was $$甲児$$'s level to begin with...?」

861:t_089:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Good work. Want to stop here for today? Then I think I'll take a break too...」

861:t_089:6.en:
$$シロー$$
「It's terrible...! I'm so starving my belly's about to stick to my back!」

861:t_089:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「Don't scare me like that... It's break time anyway, so I'll put my all into cooking something!」

861:t_089:8.en:
$$シロー$$
「I've been waiting for this! Yeah! Cooking guy! Three-star chef! It's a wonder you don't have a girlfriend!」

861:t_089:9.en:
$$甲児$$
「What's that about not having a girlfriend!? That's got nothing to do with it! Hey! Don't run away, $$シロー$$!」

861:t_090:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$號$$... Don't you have anything to say to the player?」

861:t_090:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Heh... Not bad, coming from you.」

861:t_090:10.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But $$號$$ isn't the only one waiting. I'm waiting for you to come back too.」

861:t_091:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「This is a good chance to show what the special training did for you. $$號$$, you wrap it up.」

861:t_091:5.en:
$$號$$
「A shadow aiming at Earth. Invaders from another world. A boundless destroyer that appeared in space. Humanity faced a threat like never before.」

861:t_091:7.en:
$$號$$
「Next time on '3rd Super Robot Wars Z', 'Purgatory!! The Endless Battle!' Tune in - switch on!」

861:t_091:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Not bad, $$號$$. All that training on your speaking paid off too.」

861:t_092:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey, everyone! How was it? Next up is another story where Earth gets into big trouble!」

861:t_092:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「The one who appears before us is stronger and nastier than anyone we've fought so far!」

861:t_092:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Well, this is where it's up to me and $$トライダー$$ to do something about it!」

861:t_092:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Next time on '3rd Super Robot Wars Z', 'Save the Earth! Young President!'」

861:t_092:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Be sure to play it, okay!」

861:t_093:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey, everyone! How was it? Next up is another story where I do great things!」

861:t_093:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Every single time, Earth's in trouble and it's a mess! And while we're at it, my company's in big trouble too!」

861:t_093:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「But even so, not giving up is what $$トライダー$$ and I do!」

861:t_093:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Next time on '3rd Super Robot Wars Z', 'Blast Away the Recession and the Enemies!'」

861:t_093:7.en:
$$柿小路$$
「President! There's work to do! President!」

861:t_093:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I know, I know! Then give me a cheer to get me fired up!」

861:t_094:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「Good work, everyone. You're not worn out from playing too many games, are you?」

861:t_094:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「When I use my psychic powers too much, I get headaches, palpitations, nausea and dizziness.」

861:t_094:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「Of course, as long as an evil enemy is targeting Earth, I can't afford to whine.」

861:t_094:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「So you all rest up well too, and fight alongside me again.」

861:t_095:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Once again, $$鉄人$$ and I are fighting for the peace of Earth!」

861:t_095:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「An enemy bigger than ever stands in our way!」

861:t_095:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Joining forces with our reliable comrades, we'll stand up to any opponent!」

861:t_095:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Next time on '3rd Super Robot Wars Z', 'Sortie! $$鉄人$$ and the Super Robot Army!' Look forward to it!」

861:t_096:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「There are still plenty of bad guys left! Let's go, $$鉄人$$! $$オックス$$!」

861:t_096:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「What's wrong, $$オックス$$? Sitting down like that...」

861:t_096:7.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Come to think of it, we've been fighting nonstop. Dr. $$敷島$$ did tell us to take breaks often...」

861:t_096:8.en:
$$正太郎$$
「All right, let's call it a day after all! Good work, $$鉄人$$! $$オックス$$!」

861:t_097:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「This is 'Super Robot Wars'. It's a hugely popular game on Earth.」

861:t_097:5.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I have no desire to play an Earth game.」
